statement: The verified source contains 204,469 post-2016 quote records across 37 observed waves, 2016Q2-2025Q3; 2025Q2 is absent. The current official download has 50,780,339 bytes and the frozen SHA256 f 1 d 7265 b 1856 d 61812 c 158 d 3 d 03 fae 686 dbff 58735 deabe 016 a 6 bfe 23482 d 2 a 8.

The primary source-record cohort has 45,343 eligible affordable origins: 29,546 recorded stays, 6,883 observed threshold failures and 8,914 unknown successors. The last observed wave contributes 2,083 separately right-censored affordable origins.

Among 36,429 uniquely valid core successor pairs, continuity is 0.81105712 (81.11%). Among all eligible origin records, its missing-outcome identification interval is [0.65161105, 0.84820149]. These are different targets.

Strict matching keeps the same 45,343 origins, retains 30,570 valid pairs, and gives conditional continuity 0.81046778. Its bounds are [0.54641290, 0.87221842]. The width increases by 12.9215 percentage points, although the conditional point changes by -0.0589 points.

Of the 36 eligible origin waves, 35 have strictly wider strict bounds; none narrows. There are 35 waves with valid E1 pairs. The prespecified lag 4 wave-HAC sensitivity interval for the pooled width difference is [6.64, 19.20] percentage points. This is not a validated robust 95% interval.

Corridor survey monitoring gives 8,189/8,879 = 92.23% continuity of at least one cheap surveyed quote. Its 9,168 eligible origin corridor-quarters include 289 unknown follow-up corridor surveys. Phase 3 excludes 270 right-censored final-wave corridor-quarters from the earlier 9,438-origin display; the observed follow-up denominator and conditional rate are unchanged. It does not measure persistence of the same offer and is not SmaRT.

E4 over all primary eligible records is 81.3599% for unique core reobservation and 80.3410% for unique valid-cost reobservation. This denominator differs from the earlier conditional E4 modelling population.

Eligible primary origins span 359 corridors and 474 provider labels, of which 444 labels have valid pairs. The quote-weighted conditional result must not be called an average-provider or average-corridor probability.

Core conditional continuity is 80.43% before 2022Q3 and 81.98% thereafter. Core unknown shares are 19.57% and 19.78%. These are composition-sensitive descriptions, not an identified effect of a survey change.

Equal-corridor and equal-provider-label conditional means are 69.54% and 63.21%, excluding groups without valid pairs for that conditional mean. This weighting change is material; it changes the estimand and does not correct survey selection.

The frozen Phase 2 selected research policy has Brier 0.130763 on 19,667 previously inspected records. Raw RF0.128059 and raw GBM0.128106 have lower observed Brier. Calibrated ridge 0.134707, calibrated spline 0.134912 and raw spline 0.136151 remain reported. No operational model is selected.

statement: At the 20% all-origin review capacity, the selected policy reviews 4,905 of 24,556 eligible records;4,889 outcomes are unknown overall. All-failure recall bounds are 0.216707-0.572562. No population-wide policy ranking, avoided harm or consumer saving is established.

The original strict 1e-9 comparator still has 14 exact matches,2 timing-only matches and 14 differing tables. Independent count checks match in all 20 fields tested. Separate locked Windows runs give exactly equal ridge and spline predictions on the selected 2022 fold; this is not proof of Linux numeric identity.

On the inspected 2022 legacy fold, tightening the fixed diagnostic tolerance from 1e-4 to 1e-10 changes ridge Brier from 0.156476196 to 0.156857164, and spline from 0.154414433 to 0.154575503. Maximum individual probability changes are 0.081154 and 0.041055. These probes are not new selected candidates.

A genuine invalid-cost boundary defect was fixed: infinite target costs now remain unknown. Across 408,938 source cost cells, there are 0 infinite costs, so this repair changes no observed source result.

A private seed 20261021 stratified review form contains 60 cases:12 each from unchanged matches, changed speed/network, nonmatches, ambiguous keys and potential metadata drift. Prices/automated verdicts are hidden, alternate candidates supplied and stratum key separate. External human adjudications remain 0.

Same-source firm/service price analysis is already established in Beck 2022 and Borra 2026. Matched-item replacement selection is established conceptually by Nakamura and Steinsson.
